description.value:
Trigger You use your Stock’s Quick Suture on a creature.

Duration 1 minute

Leave the incision open. Until the duration ends, the next healing effect you apply to that creature restores an additional 1d6 Hit Points, and that creature takes a −1 status penalty to saves against your Grafts. Only one creature can be Held Open at a time.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. This sets up bonus future healing plus a save penalty on a creature the caster previously used Quick Suture on -- a status placed on someone else's future rolls.
